source_text: Eleazar filius Aaron mortuus est — sepultus in Gabaath Phinees. Sacerdotium transit; Christus sacerdos in aeternum.
pass_a_gloss: Eleazar son of-Aaron dead is — buried in Gibeah of-Phinehas. Priesthood passes; Christ priest unto forever.
pass_b_english: [[Eleazar son of Aaron dies — buried at Phinehas’s hill >> Bible:Joshua 24:33]]. Priesthood passes; Christ is priest forever.
